# Software requirements 

```{r lib, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

# Prepare data for CLAM preprocessing

## Full metadata processing

```{r}
metadata_all <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC_onlyPT.csv")
```

```{r}
# Add TMA ID
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(paste0(metadata_all$grid,"x",metadata_all$x,"y",metadata_all$y),"NA","")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "x","X")
metadata_all$TMA_id <- str_replace(metadata_all$TMA_id, "y","Y")
metadata_all[is.na(metadata_all$x),]$TMA_id <- "CX7Y8" #was missing in data
```

```{r}
metadata_all$subtype_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), metadata_all$subtype, "other")
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
metadata_all$subtype_combined[metadata_all$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"
```

```{r}
## Update survival censoring
metadata_all$status_OS <- ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, metadata_all$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

metadata_all$OS_months <- metadata_all$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories
metadata_all$pT_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$pT_simple))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- metadata_all$ISUP
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(metadata_all$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", metadata_all$ISUP))
metadata_all$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(metadata_all$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", metadata_all$lymphocytes)
```


```{r}
# Make sure stage, grade and necrose are encoded as characters
metadata_all$pT_simple <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_simple))
metadata_all$pT_combined <- as.character(paste0("T",metadata_all$pT_combined))

metadata_all$ISUP_simple <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_simple))
metadata_all$ISUP_combined <- as.character(paste0("G",metadata_all$ISUP_combined))

metadata_all$necrose <- as.character(paste0("NE",metadata_all$necrose))

# Revert NAs
metadata_all$necrose[metadata_all$necrose == "NENA"] <- NA

metadata_all$ISUP_simple[metadata_all$ISUP_simple == "GNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$ISUP_combined[metadata_all$ISUP_combined == "GNA"] <- NA

metadata_all$pT_simple[metadata_all$pT_simple == "TNA"] <- NA
metadata_all$pT_combined[metadata_all$pT_combined == "TNA"] <- NA
```

```{r}
metadata_selected <- metadata_all %>% select(PID, TMA_id, subtype_combined, gender, age, age_bin, type, status_OS, OS_months, pT_simple, pT_combined, ISUP_simple, ISUP_combined, necrose) %>% as.data.frame
```

### Add ccRCC specific information

```{r}
## Add PDL1 score 
### Combined positive score (> 1%) calculated on all cells in next script 
#### Possible to add here later on
sce_PDL1 <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")

metadata_selected$PDL1_score <- sce_PDL1$PDL1_score[match(metadata_selected$PID, sce_PDL1$PID)]

metadata_selected$PDL1_score <- as.character(paste0("PD",metadata_selected$PDL1_score))
metadata_selected$PDL1_score[metadata_selected$PDL1_score == "PDNA"] <- NA
```


```{r}
## Patient groupings
metadata_PL <- as.data.frame(read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/data_analysis/metadata_key_HE.csv"))

## Add other relevant metadata based on PID
for (entry in colnames(metadata_PL)[colnames(metadata_PL) %in% c("IMC_TU_PL_PID_ICAM_mTOR_group", "IMC_MY_PL_my_HLADR_group_names", "IMC_T_PL_spatial_CD8_pheno", "BF_PL_TME_archetypes")]) {
  metadata_selected[,entry] <- metadata_PL[,entry][match(metadata_selected[,"PID"],metadata_PL[,"PID"])]
}
```

## Load HE image information 

```{r}
images <- data.frame(slide_id = list.files("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/images/"),
           TMA_id = str_split(str_split(list.files("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/images/"), "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2], ".tif", simplify = TRUE)[,1])


for (entry in colnames(metadata_selected)[!colnames(metadata_selected) %in% c("TMA_id")]) {
  images[,entry] <- metadata_selected[,entry][match(images[,"TMA_id"],metadata_selected[,"TMA_id"])]
}

images$case_id <- images$PID
```

### Select test cases

```{r}
# Select 50 cases from each histological subtype
PID_test <- images %>% select(PID, subtype_combined) %>% unique() %>% group_by(subtype_combined) %>% filter(subtype_combined != "other") %>% slice_sample(n = 50) %>% ungroup() %>% pull(PID)

images_test <- images %>% filter(PID %in% PID_test)
```

```{r}
# Move test files
from_test <- paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/images/", images_test$slide_id)

to_test <- "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM_test/raw/"

file.copy(from = from_test, to = to_test)
```

```{r}
# Prepare images_test 
images_test_out <- images_test

images_test_out$slide_id <- str_split(images_test_out$slide_id, ".tif", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
images_test_out$label <- images_test_out$subtype_combined

images_test_out <- images_test_out %>% select(case_id, slide_id, label)

write_csv(images_test_out, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/subtyping_test/metadata_subtyping_test.csv")
```

### Select main cases

#### TME archetypes 

```{r}
PID_test_out <- images %>% filter(!is.na(BF_PL_TME_archetypes))
```

```{r}
# Move test files
from_test <- paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/images/", PID_test_out$slide_id)

to_test <- "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/TME_archetypes/raw/"

file.copy(from = from_test, to = to_test)
```

```{r}
PID_test_out$slide_id <- str_split(PID_test_out$slide_id, ".tif", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
PID_test_out$label <- PID_test_out$BF_PL_TME_archetypes

PID_test_out <- PID_test_out %>% select(case_id, slide_id, label)

write_csv(PID_test_out, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/CLAM/TME_archetypes/metadata_TME_archetypes.csv")
```

## Save 

```{r}
write.csv(images, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/HE/data_analysis/metadata_images.csv")
```
